excerpt: This week's economic data focuses on jobs reports, with key earnings from Palantir, AMD, and McDonald's. Analysts forecast S&P 500 earnings growth at 19.8% for 2026, up from 11.7% and 13.6% in 2024 and 2025. Federal Reserve officials will also speak.

content.introduction: This week's economic data focuses on jobs reports, with key earnings from Palantir, AMD, and McDonald's. Analysts forecast S&P 500 earnings growth at 19.8% for 2026, up from 11.7% and 13.6% in 2024 and 2025. Federal Reserve officials will also speak.
body: By [Karee Venema](https://www.kiplinger.com/author/karee-venema). in [News](https://www.kiplinger.com/news). * [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kiplinger.com%2Finvesting%2Feconomy%2Fthis-weeks-economic-calendar). Incoming [jobs](https://www.kiplinger.com/economic-forecasts/jobs) data is the major theme of this week's economic calendar, starting with hiring and firing numbers for March on Tuesday, continuing with initial jobless claims on Wednesday and ending with the April jobs report on Friday. In the immediate aftermath of the [April Fed meeting](https://www.kiplinger.com/news/live/fed-meeting-updates-and-commentary-april-2026) and Jerome Powell's final press conference as Fed chair, we'll hear from New York Fed President John Williams on Monday and Thursday and Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee on Wednesday. [Sign up](https://www.kiplinger.com/newsletter). "We estimate that nonfarm payroll employment was flat in April," a team of Barclays economists led by [Marc Giannoni](https://www.linkedin.com/in/marcpgiannoni/) writes, "following the sharp swings in January (+160k), February (-133k) and March (+178k).". * [Kiplinger's Earnings Calendar](https://www.kiplinger.com/investing/stocks/17494/next-week-earnings-calendar-stocks). * [Kiplinger's Economic Forecasts](https://www.kiplinger.com/economic-forecasts). * [Stock Market Holidays in 2026](https://www.kiplinger.com/investing/stock-market-holidays). * [Stock Market Trading Hours](https://www.kiplinger.com/investing/602886/stock-market-trading-hours). * [Subscriptions Store](https://www.kiplinger.com/subscription). * [Kiplinger Newsletters](https://www.kiplinger.com/newsletter). * [About Kiplinger](https://www.kiplinger.com/about-us). * [Kiplinger Puzzles](https://www.kiplinger.com/puzzles). * [Stock Market Today](https://www.kiplinger.com/tag/closing-bell). * [Economic Forecasts](https://www.kiplinger.com/economic-forecasts). * [Tools and Calculators](https://www.kiplinger.com/tools).
